messages.text: BL-1853 🎵 in progress — A land reads each commit's diff once - the land plan runs git log -p for every ticket-tagged non-merge commit between origin/main and the cited tip on every land (3696 of 8069 commits on 2026-09-30); a commit's diff never changes, so it is kept by commit id and a land reads only the commits no land has read before, with the same verdict
